scares.description: While walking towards the tricycle, Jill is jumped by Hoffman in a pig mask.
Bobby is grabbed by a man in a pig mask while looking into his car from the window.
There is a sudden, very large explosion in the junkyard.
The coroner opens up a body bag, and Hoffman jumps out from inside and attacks him.
As Hoffman is walking away, he is jumped by three people in pig masks.
